units: <cite ref="Berakhot 18b">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>מתותי צ׳ דד׳</he> … <he>שקלינהו</he> Ms. M. take the money from under the door-pivot at such and such a place; ed. <he>שקלינהו מתותי בצ׳ דד׳ וכ׳</he> take it from what lies below in the socket &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:3">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>ומשלים להו אצ׳ דד׳</he> and had the money ready to settle with them as soon as the door was turned.
<cite ref="Pesachim 94b">Pes. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>כצ׳ דד׳</he> moving around its axis like a door in its socket.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 1:7">Targ. Koh. I, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:5:2">Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ</cite> bot.—V. <cite ref="R00616"><he>צִנּוֹרָה</he> II</cite>.
